t: What happens if you try to straighten it
a: الْمَرْأَةُ كَالضِّلَعِ، إِنْ أَقَمْتَهَا كَسَرْتَهَا، وَإِنِ اسْتَمْتَعْتَ بِهَا اسْتَمْتَعْتَ بِهَا وَفِيهَا عِوَجٌ
p: Al-marʾatu ka-ḍ-ḍilaʿ. In aqamtahā kasartahā, wa ini-stamtaʿta bihā-stamtaʿta bihā wa fīhā ʿiwaj
m: A woman is like a rib. If you try to straighten it you break it. And if you take comfort in it, you take comfort in it while it still has its curve.
